question: Out of indigo, green, orange and yellow colours, which colour has the least refractive index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Orange**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Orange light has a lower refractive index compared to indigo, green, and yellow lights.
 
• The refractive index of a color decreases as the wavelength of the light increases. Orange light has a longer wavelength compared to indigo, green, and yellow.
 
• Refractive index is inversely related to the speed of light in the medium. Orange light, having a lower refractive index, travels faster in a medium compared to indigo, green, and yellow lights.
 
• Therefore, among the given options, orange light bends the least when passing through a prism, indicating it has the lowest refractive index.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Refractive Index:**

 
 
• The refractive index of a material is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced inside the material compared to the speed of light in a vacuum.
 
• It is a dimensionless number, typically greater than 1, and is denoted by the letter 'n'.
 
• The refractive index can be calculated using the formula n = c/v, where c is the speed of light in a vacuum and v is the speed of light in the material.
 
 
 
• **Dispersion of Light:**
 
 
• When light passes through a prism, it is separated into its constituent colors, a process known as dispersion.
 
• Different colors of light bend by different amounts due to their varying refractive indices.
 
• Violet and indigo light, having shorter wavelengths, bend more than red and orange light, which have longer wavelengths.
 
 
 
• **Wavelength and Frequency:**
 
 
• The wavelength of light is the distance between successive peaks of the electromagnetic waves.
 
• Frequency is the number of wave cycles that pass a point per unit time, typically measured in hertz (Hz).
 
• There is an inverse relationship between wavelength and frequency: λ = c/f, where λ is the wavelength, c is the speed of light, and f is the frequency.
 
 
 
• **Prisms and Light Bending:**
 
 
• A prism is a transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light.
 
• The angle at which light enters and exits the prism affects how much it bends and how it is dispersed into its constituent colors.
 
• Prisms are commonly used in spectrometers to analyze light and determine the wavelengths present in a light source.
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 2**__.
